Definition: literally a whatness (so to speak), i.e. manna (so called from the question about it)
BiblicalUsage: 1) manna; 1a) the bread from Heaven that fed the Israelites for 40 years of wilderness wanderings; 1b) means 'What is it?'
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
